notes.v1_07: Steel Safe: Paint the safe a slightly lighter mid royal blue, with soft bright highlights along the top edges and a gently darker right side. Add a soft light glow on the pink wall behind the safe. Keep the gold dial, the handle, the hinges, the magenta backdrop and the view.
notes.v1_06: Evidence Bag: Replace the dark mahogany planks with bright, warm honey-orange wood with a few broad, soft grain bands. Give the bag a soft, slightly darker shadow on the wood toward the lower right. Keep the bag, the blue zip and the gold ring.
